concerns.text: T024 and T026 implement training for FIM and NL-Control models, but there is no task to generate the 'Baseline' model (no mid-training) required by FR-004 and SC-001. Without a task to load the base TinyLlama-110M and run evaluation on it, the statistical comparison in Phase 5 is impossible to execute.

T018 describes implementing 'overlap check logic' but lacks a concrete deliverable task to EXECUTE this check as a blocking gate. FR-001 mandates the build MUST fail if overlap > 0. The task list needs a specific task (e.g., 'Run overlap validation script and fail build on positive result') to ensure this is not just a library function but an enforced pipeline step.

T018 mentions checking 'GSM8K (train) and LogiQA (test) examples' but FR-001 explicitly requires verifying zero overlap with 'intermediate caches' of GSM8K examples. The task description is incomplete and does not instruct the implementer to check cache artifacts, risking a failure to meet the spec's data hygiene requirement.

T034 and T035 describe statistical analysis generically ('compare groups'). FR-005 and SC-002 require comparing FIM against BOTH NL-Control AND Baseline. The task description does not explicitly mandate including the Baseline in the t-test/Wilcoxon calculation, which could lead to an implementation that only compares FIM vs. NL-Control, failing the research question.

Constitution Principle VII and Plan.md require 'format-based leakage verification' to ensure the pseudo-code structure doesn't encode test-set info. Phase 3 tasks (T014-T020) cover conversion and graph validation but lack a specific task to perform this format-based leakage check on the generated pseudo-code structure.

SC-005 requires measuring the 'rate of successful dependency graph construction' against a target. T020 only implements a 'depth-distribution validator' with error code VAR-001. There is no task to calculate and report the success rate metric (successful_graphs / total_examples) required by SC-005.
